name: tiles-margin
stage: offline gate, then an e2e screen (both predeclared here, before any training or game)

data.shards: runs/value-v2-100k-shards (the arch-bakeoff-v1 data: same split train 2650000+95000 / test 2745000+5000, point end_turn, stride 3)
data.final_points: recovered by replaying each seeded game on its own producer snapshot; a replay counts only if its winner and turn count equal the stored record (any mismatch excludes that game's rows from the margin target and is reported); output runs/value100k-final-points-v1 with per-game final public+hidden VP for all seats
data.margin_target: per row: (row seat's final VP) − (max final VP of the other three seats), divided by 10; truncated games excluded from the margin loss (none expected)

arm.name: tiles_margin
arm.model: arch_bakeoff 'tiles' trunk and P(I win) head exactly as arch-bakeoff-v1 (d 128, 4 layers, 4 heads, MLP 256, dropout .1), plus a linear margin head on the global token; same common training settings as arch-bakeoff-v1 (AdamW 7e-4, wd .05, cosine 3% warmup, 12 epochs, batch 4096, 12-symmetry augmentation, seed 0)
arm.deciding_value: P(I win) only (the margin head is an auxiliary training target, as in shengji M1); serving uses the unchanged NumPy tiles forward with the new weights
arm.epoch_selection: lowest validation BCE of P(I win) on the last 5,000 train games; never test

offline_gate.primary: non-inferior and better-ranking on the 5,000 test games' rows: AUC(tiles_margin) − AUC(arch-bakeoff-v1 tiles, .7859) >= 0 with the game-clustered bootstrap 95% LCB > −0.002 (1,000 resamples, seed 29), AND within-decision cross-eval (scripts/cross_eval_arch.py on the pv2b test decisions) pick − served point estimate >= the tiles model's +.0062
offline_gate.reported: test AUC, log loss, ECE, margin-head MAE/correlation on test rows, xeval with truncation eligibility

screen.tables: tactical / mixed / self as in pv2-tiles-precise (self = three planner_offer_accept opponents)
screen.gate: +.02 paired lift over planner_pv2_tiles on every table, 0 truncations, p95 decision <= 2 s, step max <= 2 s, turn max <= 10 s
screen.power: alternative +.04 over the current transformer bot, planning sigma .22 (largest cluster SD observed in pv2-tiles-precise .249 was vs the served bot; head-to-head of two close PV bots is expected lower, so .22 is declared, not measured); check_design must admit it

note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before replay, training or any game (Jerry: 'Yes try 3 and screen it', after the metric study showed final-VP margin about as informative as wins and the arch-bakeoff 'heads' arm never had a margin target). Weights stay local; only metadata is committed.
